reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web chat UI enhancement that adds a visual message navigation rail for locating and jumping within conversation history, with hover previews and drag-to-scrub interactions; package metadata shows it is a web-only client plugin bundle, and the README states it operates on already-rendered chat nodes without modifying conversation data or running host commands.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面提供消息导航轨道，可在会话中快速预览和跳转到目标消息。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness chat UI add-on that shows a message map rail for quick previewing and navigating to specific messages in a conversation.

capabilities: Render a chat-side message navigation rail based on rendered conversation nodes
Display hover summaries on message markers
Support click-to-jump navigation with smooth-scroll behavior
Support dragging/scrubbing markers to scan messages quickly
Synchronize navigation state with message additions, history loads, resize, and scrolling
